name: Prism Rain Symphony
description: Rain frozen mid-fall, each droplet a perfect prism refracting the world into spectra, suspended on invisible strings like a harp waiting for wind to play it.
prompt: Rain frozen mid-fall in vast cathedral space, each droplet a perfect geometric prism refracting surroundings into full spectra, suspended on invisible tension threads like harp strings, rainbow caustics painting surfaces, single shaft of white light entering, macro detail on droplet facets, physics-defying stillness, 8k, optical photography style
caption: Every raindrop holds a rainbow. This storm holds them all. 🌈💧
